content.purpose: Provide a DID-addressed electric distribution operations service (substation/feeder design + meter readings + outage reporting) as an auditable, open-source reference implementation.

architectureDescriptionContext.mission: Provide tamper-evident, DID-native distribution-grid primitives open to any AT Protocol client.

content.findings: Topology = directed substation → service-point edges sufficient for radial distribution. Outage classifier auto-routes regulatory notifications.
content.recommendations: Add SCADA ingest (kinesis/MQTT), introduce CIM-conformant equipment hierarchy, add ENS / ASIDI / SAIDI metric derivations.
